name: Unidentified blaster pistol model
description: A type of blaster pistol that was owned by Clone Commander Scorch, a clone commando in service to the Galactic Empire's Advanced Science Division. The blaster was largely black in color, while the top of the gun barrel and a line across each weapon's side was silver. Between that silver barrel portion and the rest of the pistol was also a blue coloration, with a red line present on each side above where a soldier's hand held the blaster pistol. The back of the pistol also featured a green line.
